SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = '已退货' THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 0) AS value
FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) >= strftime('%Y-%m', date_trunc('month', DATE '2026-09-01') - INTERVAL (5) MONTH) AND o.region = '华南'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)
ORDER BY value ASC
LIMIT 100

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity) AS value
FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) >= strftime('%Y-%m', date_trunc('month', DATE '2026-09-01') - INTERVAL (11) MONTH)
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100

WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) >= strftime('%Y-%m', date_trunc('month', DATE '2026-09-01') - INTERVAL (11) MONTH) AND o.channel = '官网'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100
